Cloud Scheduler Trigger: Auto-launch pending groups
post.description:
Invoked periodically by Google Cloud Scheduler (e.g. every 1 minute).
Checks and activates groups whose start times or capacity conditions have matured.

post.summary: Cloud Scheduler Trigger: Process due group payout disbursements
post.description:
Invoked periodically by Google Cloud Scheduler (e.g. every 2 minutes).
Finds matured payouts, verifies rules, and safely executes disbursements using row locks.

post.summary: Cloud Scheduler Trigger: Process daily group late fees
post.description:
Invoked periodically by Google Cloud Scheduler (e.g. hourly or daily).
Calculates and levies late penalty fees on delinquent members.

post.summary: Cloud Scheduler Trigger: Process group health ratings
post.description:
Invoked periodically by Google Cloud Scheduler (e.g. every 6 hours).
Computes reputation scores and defaults across all active savings groups.

post.summary: Cloud Tasks Trigger: Asynchronous verified email delivery
post.description:
Invoked asynchronously by Google Cloud Tasks.
Dispatches verified transactional emails via Resend with automatic retries.

post.summary: Cloud Tasks Trigger: Asynchronous FCM push notification delivery
post.description:
Invoked asynchronously by Google Cloud Tasks.
Sends push notifications to Android client via Firebase Cloud Messaging.

post.summary: Cloud Tasks Trigger: Asynchronous SMS text message delivery
post.description:
Invoked asynchronously by Google Cloud Tasks.
Sends SMS alerts via Africa's Talking gateway.

post.summary: Inbound Payment Gateway Confirmation
post.description: Secured endpoint invoked by the dedicated payment gateway project to confirm completed mobile money collections.
